description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and built on burgers made from 100% fresh Canadian beef alongside locally sourced BC chicken, dairy, and produce. The Tsawwassen location is a full-service family restaurant with a patio, dine-in, takeout, and delivery options, situated close to the BC Ferries terminal — a practical refuelling stop for cyclists on the Tsawwassen–Vancouver Island route. The menu spans breakfast through dinner and accommodates vegetarian and vegan diners.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active White Spot at 1199 56th Street, Tsawwassen, with phone 604-943-5715 matching OSM. The website lists Patio, Dine in, Curbside Pickup, Take Out, and Delivery as amenities, contradicting OSM tags outdoor_seating=no and delivery=no; the website is preferred. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are consistent with the website's allergy guide and allergy-accommodation language, confirming vegan/vegetarian options; no bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere in the website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible family restaurant near the Tsawwassen BC Ferries terminal; a practical stop for touring cyclists.
